remarks: Charming, 4 Bed/2 Bath freshly painted Cape near schools, the Noroton Heights train station, dining and shopping. Updated eat in kitchen with granite counters, stainless fridge and dishwasher plus a new stove. Hardwood floors throughout the home. Four bedrooms that can be reconfigured into a den or office. Deck from the kitchen overlooks the large partially fenced yard. DECK IS BEING REPLACED. Property has been completely seeded and landscaped. This home has a generous, unfinished, dry basement with washer and dryer. You will find window units and an attic fan to keep the house cool. One car garage and driveway for parking. The tenant pays for utilities, oil, snow removal and lawn maintenance, credit check and 2 months security plus 1st months' rent. Sorry, no pets. No smoking or vaping. MUST USE RENTSPREE
